How does the sample library inventory workflow fit together?

ChatGPT:
Synthetic library inventory workflow

An example library receives a spreadsheet of donated books and routes checked records to two destinations.

Input: Donation spreadsheet and shelf list
                 │
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Spreadsheet intake                       │
│ Open the sample inventory in read-only mode │
│ Note the workbook name and worksheet label  │
│ Assign a batch label for the donation       │
│ Keep a copy of the raw cells for comparison │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 2. Field classification                     │
│ Identify titles, authors and series names   │
│ Separate accession numbers from shelf IDs   │
│ Mark blank fields and duplicate titles      │
│ Keep donor notes separate from book fields  │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 3. Catalog planning                         │
│ Choose the shelf vocabulary for this batch  │
│ Assign likely destinations for each record  │
│ Collect questions for the reviewing clerk   │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 4. Record assembly                          │
│ Attach the batch label to each record       │
│ Combine checked fields into catalog rows    │
│ Preserve the original workbook references   │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                 ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 5. Validation and reporting                 │
│ Check required fields and duplicate IDs     │
│ Record review notes and rejected rows       │
│ Preserve the source worksheet identity      │
└────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                 ▼
          Catalog output
            /        \
    Shelving queue   Review queue
